tasks.short: Monitor prompt payment of hand-delivered jackpots

steps.what: Monitor actual open hand-pay cases, their recorded times and current payment status
inputs: existing actual hand-pay case records and timestamps
outputs: supervisor-checked overdue or unresolved hand-pay cases

steps.what: Check actual floor circumstances and payment progress for the cases needing attention
inputs: supervisor-checked overdue or unresolved hand-pay cases
outputs: supervisor-confirmed actual payment delay or stale status

steps.what: Speak with responsible payment staff about the actual delay and confirm what needs attention
inputs: supervisor-confirmed actual payment delay or stale status
outputs: responsible staff informed and actual payment-progress questions resolved

tasks.design: Configure an age-sorted native hand-pay view in {OPS_SYSTEM} using existing case times and payment status. The supervisor checks real floor progress and speaks with responsible staff; the view neither authorizes nor pays a jackpot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scanning of pending cases can obscure older unresolved payments.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queue sorting and threshold highlighting can expose age from existing timestamps.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish an actual delay from stale case status or a legitimate unresolved issue.
tasks.human_edge: Follow up with staff using real payment circumstances.

ambition.what: Improve visibility of actual hand-pay delays.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: payment queues can display existing timestamps and statuses; physical follow-up establishes actual hand-pay progress.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the existing gambling hand-pay register. Existing hand-pay creation and cashier payment work produce timestamps/status before monitoring; their labor is not saved or newly automated here. No invented paid flag or extra status capture.
Native sorting/highlighting first. Missing or stale timestamps require manual follow-up, not an inferred delay. No separate notification, payout action or new monitoring log is created.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 12 minus 1 threshold/view upkeep gives 11 net. Existing queue monitoring already sorted by age has no new saving.
unknowns: Timestamp reliability, status freshness and current native queue view
research_questions: Does age highlighting reduce actual queue-scanning time while preserving checks on stale status?

incremental.description: Maintain promptness thresholds and inspect stale status patterns

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if queue already adequate or source times unreliable; cautious range below provisional 11% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain and interpret house rules for patrons

steps.what: Look up the actual current house rule or betting limit relevant to the patron's question
inputs: current approved house rules and table limits
outputs: supervisor-checked applicable rule and its scope

steps.what: Explain and interpret the actual house rule for the patron and resolve their questions
inputs: supervisor-checked applicable rule and its scope
outputs: patron's rule question addressed with the applicable limits explained

tasks.design: Configure native rule bookmarks and table-limit links in {DOCS}. The supervisor checks the actual applicable text and explains it directly; no generated rule or automated betting advice is supplied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the relevant current rule can interrupt the explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed documents and bookmarks can link approved rule sections.
tasks.still_hard: Interpret scope fairly and handle misunderstanding or disagreement.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the rule clearly to the patron in context.

ambition.what: Reduce source navigation while retaining direct interpretation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed house-rule documents can reduce lookup time; supervisors still interpret and explain the applicable rule to patrons.

assumptions: House-rule owner produces the current approved source. Supervisor reads it in s1. No new structured patron profile, generated rule or promotion of gambling is involved.

Native bookmarks first. No separate written response or incident record is established for an ordinary rule question; if a dispute requires one, map its actual authoring and send rather than folding it into conversation.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 1.5 minus 0.2 bookmark upkeep gives 1.3 net; explanation stays fully retained.
unknowns: Actual lookup burden and current rule-document navigation
research_questions: Do native section links reduce lookup without pointing to obsolete table limits?

already_counted.description: Check applicable rule text before explaining it

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if source access already sufficient; cautious range below provisional 1.3% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record malfunctioning-machine specifics and repair needs

steps.what: Observe the actual machine malfunction and distinguish symptoms from an unconfirmed cause
inputs: actual malfunctioning machine and observed behavior
outputs: supervisor's actual malfunction symptoms and uncertainty

steps.what: Read the actual machine identifier, location and available fault indication
inputs: existing fault display or explicit absence
outputs: source-checked machine identity and displayed fault information

steps.what: Write the malfunction and repair-needed record, using native verbatim dictation where useful and correcting its transcription
inputs: supervisor's actual malfunction symptoms and uncertainty
source-checked machine identity and displayed fault information

steps.what: Check the complete record against actual machine identity, symptoms, fault indication and required repair attention
inputs: supervisor's actual malfunction symptoms and uncertainty
source-checked machine identity and displayed fault information

steps.what: Save the checked malfunction record in the same machine record

tasks.design: Use native verbatim dictation in the malfunction form in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The supervisor supplies the actual description, corrects recognition errors and checks the finished record; no system diagnoses the fault or dispatches a repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: Typing the actual observed malfunction narrative can be slow on the floor.
tasks.enabler_now: Native speech entry can transcribe the supervisor's own words into the existing draft form.
tasks.still_hard: Describe a reproducible symptom without guessing its cause.
tasks.human_edge: Observe and distinguish actual machine behavior from speculation.

ambition.what: Reduce narrative typing while retaining source capture and checking.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; speech-entry processing permission and staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native speech entry can transcribe dictated fault descriptions; recognition correction and source checks remain necessary, especially for identifiers and codes.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the existing machine malfunction record. Actual observation in s1 and identity/fault lookup in s2 produce source facts; the supervisor speaks the description in s3. Speaking and correction are included in its retained 80%.
Native verbatim input first, no ambient recording or semantic rewrite. No cause, severity or repair completion is inferred. The task documents repair needs; no hidden repair request send.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 9.8 minus 1 speech-setting/vocabulary upkeep gives 8.8 net. Existing final record checking and 1% same-system save remain fully retained.
unknowns: Floor noise, speech processing permission and actual typing versus correction time
research_questions: Does native dictation reduce total narrative entry including speaking and corrections without corrupting machine identifiers or fault codes?

already_counted.description: Speak, correct and check actual malfunction narrative

incremental.description: Maintain dictation settings and inspect recognition failures

approvals.approved_version: final machine-malfunction record checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if dictation already used or noise makes correction slower; cautious range below provisional 8.8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe patrons for gambling-harm signs and offer assistance

steps.what: Observe actual patron behavior and context for signs requiring an appropriate assistance response
Approach and offer assistance when appropriate, listen to the patron and follow the approved support procedure
outputs: actual assistance offered and patron response observed

steps.what: Write and check the existing assistance-case entry with actual observations, assistance and response
inputs: actual assistance offered and patron response observed

steps.what: Save the checked assistance-case entry in the same restricted record

tasks.design: Retain direct observation, assistance and the existing restricted case entry in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Native case headings already support this scenario; no behavior score or automated diagnosis replaces judgement or the patron conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assistance depends on actual behavior, context and the patron's response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing assistance records organize facts but do not establish a safe automatic intervention decision.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize concern without overinterpreting limited observations and offer appropriate help.
tasks.human_edge: Respond discreetly and listen to the patron.

ambition.what: Keep assistance decisions and contact with trained staff.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no new patron profiling or processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: gambling-harm assistance involves contextual observation and direct communication; records should distinguish observed behavior from inferred diagnosis.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the existing restricted patron-assistance record in a documented-assistance scenario. Supervisor produces actual observations and response facts; no automated behavioral surveillance or inferred clinical label.

Record entry and save are split from floor observation and conversation. Native headings are already available; no extra report, self-approval stage or administrative baseline is added. If no case entry is locally required, retain observation and assistance without claiming record savings.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios; all work retained, gross and net zero. Same-system save is 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Actual assistance policy, case-entry requirement and access restrictions
research_questions: Observe the actual assistance record separately from the patron interaction and identify any real duplicate entry before estimating it.

already_counted.description: Author and check actual assistance facts

approvals.approved_version: complete actual assistance entry checked at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual observation, assistance and existing native case entry all retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
